decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The demolition of the western gatehouse shall not commence until full details of the proposed landscaping of the area vacated by the gatehouse have been approved in writing by the local planning authority, and all landscaping shall be carried out in accordance with those details within 3 months of the demolition of the gatehouse.

Condition : 2 - The refurbishment works shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the details submitted, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority, before the building is occupied.
description: Following approval for 'Change of use of 8 Amalgamated Drive from car park to B1 and/or B8, demolition of gatehouse & erection of wall to Great West Road frontage, installation of canopies to units 1-6 Windsor Close, provision of replacement car parking & rearrangement of car park area along West Cross Way.  Installation of vehicular speed restrictions & pedestrian safety measures incorporating landscaping & general improvements' - details submitted pursuant to Condition 13 (repair & maintenance schedule for gatehouse & fence) of permission dated  28/6/01
